answer: Each agent must post a violet-tagged collateral bond and a relic of its prior epoch proof at every graph vertex, binding identity to sunk capital. Recursive SNARK composition over pairing-friendly cycles then verifies these bonds succinctly, so a sybil cluster cannot reuse one proof across many pseudonyms without fragmenting its stake. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
